pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions consist of irregular polygonal geometries with soft-to-medium edge pixel gradients. Spatial area is heterogeneous, with larger, more elongated patches on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more condensed rhomboidal structures toward the dorsal ridge.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative space forms a continuous, multi-nodal graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-functional and quad-functional. The pathway thickness is relatively broad and consistent, maintaining connectivity across the entire visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a 1D geometric contour with low-amplitude, high-frequency vertical protrusions. The silhouette against the background foliage is fuzzy rather than sharp, indicating fine-bristle hair structure.
